weapons.name: Bloodpact's Pledge
weapons.description: This weapon is a testament to the unbreakable blood pact: One shall never betray, never surrender, and fight until the last drop of blood is shed.
weapons.availability: Reward from The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier quest

weapons.name: Variation
weapons.description: A pair of pistols that can adapt to any situation, changing their form and function as needed.

weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
weapons.description: A sword forged from a mysterious green crystal that resonates with the power of creation.

weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
weapons.description: A rectifier that channels the power of the stars, creating a symphony of cosmic energy.

weapons.name: Call of the Abyss
weapons.description: A massive blade that resonates with the depths of the abyss, calling forth dark energy.

weapons.name: Stringmaster
weapons.description: Gauntlets that allow the wielder to manipulate invisible strings, controlling the battlefield like a puppet master.

weapons.name: Red Spring
weapons.description: Dual pistols that bloom with crimson energy, like flowers in spring.

weapons.name: Jinzhou Keeper
weapons.description: A traditional sword used by the guardians of Jinzhou, passed down through generations.

weapons.name: Novaburst
weapons.description: A rectifier that channels energy like a supernova, releasing bursts of power.

weapons.name: Whispers of Sirens
weapons.description: A mysterious rectifier that resonates with the deep sea. Its wielder can hear the whispers of ancient sirens calling from the abyss.

weapons.name: Thunderclap
weapons.description: A massive blade that generates thunder with each swing, striking fear into enemies.

weapons.name: Blazing Justice
weapons.description: It heralds justice, precise and inexorable as a clock's toll. All sins are cleansed in flame, dissipating like night beneath the dawn's gaze.

weapons.name: Woodland Aria
weapons.description: All things exist within the lines of poetry. Every sound has its meters and rhymes.The forest's melodies ascend in spirals toward the moon's silvered grace, harmonized by the nightingales' chorus. When the final note falls and vanishes into the silent earth, a flawless chord echoes endlessly in the depths of this boundless realm.

weapons.name: Defier's Thorn
weapons.description: The surging tides force the crown of thorns upon the knight, out of which the knight forges this sword.Unburdened by the crown, the knight waded through the roaring waves unwaveringly.

weapons.name: Wildfire Mark
weapons.description: The young wolf races through the wilds, shedding every shadow that once held her back.The lone wolf strides into the arena, cutting down each obstacle in her path.She seizes victory. She claims glory. She raises everything she has high above. She belongs to the arena, but even more, she belongs to herself.

weapons.name: Lethean Elegy
weapons.description: I am not there. I do not die. I shall be death's companion—with euphoric delights I drown my fear, with the coming days I trade for the past.

weapons.name: Thunderflare Dominion
weapons.description: Thunder shall purge her pain and weakness. From the crucible of blood and sand, the Sun rises. Not dimmed by dust, but ablaze in her full radiance.

weapons.name: Moongazer's Sigil
weapons.description: By what means do all things endure? By light and heat, by matter and word, by the mechanics of converging chances, by the soft dissolution into silence, by a moment that mimics the eternal... All things rise and fall in endless rhythm, each bearing its meaning. As for hers, it lies here within her grasp.

weapons.name: Lux & Umbra
weapons.description: From darkness she seizes power, layering sins upon herself.To hunt. To kill. To deliver a relentless and fatal blow to all evil.From the light she falls, with her vows etched in her mind.For the deceased. For the living. For her pistols’ true targets.

weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
weapons.description: Bamboo, hollow yet full; People, whole yet seldom true. Bamboo speaks without deceit, acts without conceit, seeks no vanity. Few ever measure up thus.

weapons.name: Kumokiri
weapons.description: A crimson thread emerges in the void, as if binding the structures of all things onto a single thread.At her fingertips, the endless season is drawn taut, snipped, and rewoven, until the scattered path at last converges once more upon this timeline.

weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
weapons.description: Prismatic light dances at her fingertips, arcs of color carving radiant trails. Every rushing hue converges upon her aim, and at last, she reaches a sky where nothing lies beyond her sight.

weapons.name: Starfield Calibrator
weapons.description: Every pattern can be observed. Every phenomenon can be understood. The ideal may lie light-years away, yet the path towards it rests within her own hands.

weapons.name: Everbright Polestar
weapons.description: As you drift across the hushed sea of stars, stardust scatters beside you as time crumbles in your wake. All that remains is the unyielding loneliness, warped, diluted, and remade into the plumes of your wings.The universe sends you on a tribulation of silence, yet you travel on, repaying in radiance.

weapons.name: Daybreaker's Spine
weapons.description: Those are not ridges of the mountains, but the spine of the earth, carrying the night. They protrude from the abdomen of darkness. From the incision spills the light of new life.Your shadow was nailed to the dying night. With the breaking dawn, your flesh shall rise.Let it knock open every door of denial.

weapons.name: Solsworn Ciphers
weapons.description: Sunlight gathers. The answer is made plain.What must be done awaits. The Rein is in your hand.Step forward, toward the sunlit end.

weapons.name: Frostburn
weapons.description: How keen a blade it takes to impale this unrelenting night?She presses ever forward for the answer, those unbound wishes roaring in her veins.

weapons.name: Forged Dwarf Star
weapons.description: Dream dissolves like foam, leaving only a silent white dwarf.Yet the light that once swept the cosmos remains.She waits in quiescence until her borrowed light finds its way back to the main sequence star.

weapons.name: Spectral Trigger
weapons.description: A neon glow gilds this cage of memory, same as always.I wander along old city streets, spilling unspoken words to shadows long gone.I wanna stay lost here, but the dream is fraying. I must wake up.

weapons.name: Skull Thrasher
weapons.description: Because death is a reality that cannot be undone, there's no reason to hesitate.She pulls the trigger, shattering this haunting reverie.

weapons.name: Freeze Frame
weapons.description: I remember the sunset spilling down, birds and insects threading their small songs through the greenhouse.I remember the quiet nights, my lone steps echoing the crescent moon's curve.I am my own freeze frame. I am my own afterimage.

weapons.name: Azure Oath
weapons.description: Forged of flowing wind, sheathed in the azure sky. Once the blade is drawn, all sound falls still.That never-fading azure is her resolve, her vow, and her ideal.

weapons.name: Firstlight's Herald
weapons.description: Dawn's glow my paper, morning dew my ink, with brush in hand, a scroll of ceaseless landscapes I paint.So the legend goes: when the divine bird lowers its gaze, the mountains hush and the rivers still.Yet, when it raises its head again to loose a piercing cry, the slumbering sun shall rise from beyond the sea of clouds.

weapons.name: Glint of Clouds
weapons.description: Wreathed in mist and cloud, still waters blend with the sky in seamless blue. Sparse shadows slant across as a rain of petals falls.May I bear this jade blade into the mortal realm, cleanse a tarnished age, and put the wicked to the sword.

weapons.name: Thousandfold Deliverance
weapons.description: Endless stretches the Netherworld; the long night knows no end. Ten thousand souls lie hushed, and all sound fades to silence.When cold, golden rays illuminate the Nether Gate, the sunken dreams of ages past shall at last be brought to light.

weapons.name: Blooming Jadehaven
weapons.description: Jade to pillars, gold to nexus, a hundred mechanisms meshed into one working. Infinite forms divide and proliferate among the blooms, and it still fits in the palm of Her hand. Walls and mechanisms know no feeling. What makes a life's work worth the life is not the making, but that something in it was loved.

weapons.name: Unspoken Rue
weapons.description: Unknown

weapons.name: Aureate Zenith
weapons.description: A Broadblade awarded to Gladiators of exceptional merit. Its engravings draw inspiration from Griffrexes—natural-born hunters and the first allies Septimontians found in this land. Their bond needs no words, radiant and pure, like the blazing sun that watches over all.

weapons.name: Feather Edge
weapons.description: A Sword awarded to Gladiators of exceptional merit. Its engravings draw inspiration from Griffrexes—natural-born hunters and the first allies Septimontians found in this land. Their bond needs no words, radiant and pure, like the blazing sun that watches over all.

weapons.name: Solar Flame
weapons.description: A pair of Pistols awarded to Gladiators of exceptional merit. Its engravings draw inspiration from Griffrexes—natural-born hunters and the first allies Septimontians found in this land. Their bond needs no words, radiant and pure, like the blazing sun that watches over all.

weapons.name: Aether Strike
weapons.description: A pair of Gauntlets awarded to Gladiators of exceptional merit. Its engravings draw inspiration from Griffrexes—natural-born hunters and the first allies Septimontians found in this land. Their bond needs no words, radiant and pure, like the blazing sun that watches over all.

weapons.description: A Rectifier awarded to Gladiators of exceptional merit. Its engravings draw inspiration from Griffrexes—natural-born hunters and the first allies Septimontians found in this land. Their bond needs no words, radiant and pure, like the blazing sun that watches over all.
